editorial:
Imagine waking up one day and finding out your dad is back after being gone for fifteen years without a word. That is exactly what happens to the lead character in this story. You get to follow a young man who is already struggling with his mental health as he tries to figure out why his father left and where he has been all this time. The mood is heavy and mysterious, making you feel the same confusion and stress that the son feels. It feels like a puzzle where the pieces do not quite fit, and you will find yourself questioning what is real and what is just in the main character's head.

The acting is top notch and makes the emotional scenes feel very real. While the story moves a bit slow at the start, the payoff at the end is worth the wait. You might find some parts a bit sad, but if you love a good mystery that keeps you guessing, you will love this. For the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the small details. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out that the father never actually came back. The whole reunion was a break from reality caused by the son's grief and mental health struggles. He created a version of his father to deal with the pain of the disappearance. Once he accepts the truth that his father is truly gone, he finally starts to heal. It ends with him finding peace and moving forward with his life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological mysteries and emotional family stories.
